message.content:
Here is the exact, detailed specification for rebuilding the web app home page:

### 1) Header
*   **Left:** Logo text **"Flowsheet"** (Bold, Black) followed by **"AI-NATIVE PROCESS SIMULATOR"** (Uppercase, lighter gray, smaller font).
*   **Right:** A circular icon button containing a **moon/sun toggle** icon.

### 2) Hero Section
*   **Top Badge:** A small pill-shaped tag with a plus icon: **"+ AI-NATIVE PROCESS SIMULATOR"**.
*   **Headline (Left):**
    *   Line 1: **"Describe any chemical"**
    *   Line 2: **"plant."**
    *   Line 3: **"Watch AI engineer it"**
    *   Line 4: **"— live."**
    *(Note: The first two lines are black, the last two are dark gray.)*
*   **Subtext (Left):**
    "Type a sentence — any route, any capacity. An architect plans it, an engineer wires every unit and stream, a solver closes the mass and energy balance, and a critic signs it off. Then walk your plant with a narrated, scored tour. No installs — everything runs and solves in your browser."
*   **CTA Buttons (Left):**
    1.  Primary Button (Black background, white text): **"+ Build a plant with AI"**
    2.  Secondary Button (White background, gray border, black text): **"Start at the basics ↓"**
*   **Hero Demo Panel (Right):**
    *   **Window Bar:** Contains a dot indicator, text **"AI PLANT BUILDER · LIVE LOOP"**, and a timer reading **"2.8s"**.
    *   **Layout:** Split view.
        *   **Main Stage (Left/Center):** Large empty area with a status message at the bottom left: **"▶ reading the brief.."**
        *   **Side Rail (Right):** Light gray panel titled **"DESCRIBE YOUR PLANT"**. It contains a text box with the prompt: **"Build a 500 t/day methanol plant — natural gas feed, steam"** followed by a blinking cursor **"|"**. Below this are three faded role labels: **"ARCHITECT"**, **"ENGINEER"**, and **"CRITIC"**.

### 3) Section Headings (In Order)
1.  **"YOUR PROJECTS ¹"** (Small uppercase, with a superscript '1'. To the right is an **"Import"** link with a download icon).
2.  **"THE LEARNING PATH"** (Small uppercase).

### 4) Every Card Visible

#### Section: YOUR PROJECTS

**Card 1: New Project (Dashed Border)**
*   **Visuals:** Dotted border container. Centered is a circle with a **"+"** icon.
*   **Title:** **"New project"**
*   **Description:** "Describe any plant — the agents design, wire and solve it, live"

**Card 2: Router Stress Test (Solid Border)**
*   **Thumbnail Content:** A process flow diagram (PFD) showing boxes connected by lines. Labels visible include "NATURAL GAS", "FEED PREHEAT", "PRIMARY REFORMER", "HIGH-TEMP SHIFT", "WASTE-HEAT", "SYNGAS COOLER", "PURGE SPLIT", "FLASH DRUM", "LOOP MIXER".
*   **Title:** **"Router Stress Test"**
*   **Date (Top Right of card content):** "Sep 14"
*   **Stats Row:** **"10 UNITS · 15 STREAMS · 512 T/D"**
*   **Badge:** A pill-shaped outline badge reading **"CRITIC 02"**

#### Section: THE LEARNING PATH

**Card 3: Flash Separation**
*   **Badges (Top Left):** **"LEVEL 1 · BEGINNER"** (Outline pill), **"START HERE"** (Solid black pill, white text).
*   **Thumbnail Content:** Simple PFD showing a feed stream splitting into two, going through a vessel (flash drum), and exiting as two streams.
*   **Title:** **"Flash Separation"**
*   **Description:** "One stream in, two phases out — the atom of every separation process. Three units, four streams, one guided tour. Fifteen minutes."
*   **Link Text:** **"Start learning →"**

**Card 4: Distillation**
*   **Badge (Top Left):** **"LEVEL 2 · INTERMEDIATE"** (Outline pill).
*   **Thumbnail Content:** PFD featuring a tall vertical column (distillation tower) with multiple inlet/outlet streams, a reboiler at the bottom, and a condenser at the top.
*   **Title:** **"Distillation"**
*   **Description:** "Benzene from toluene, tray by tray — the flash drum stacked into a tower. Six units, nine streams, reflux and reboil. Forty minutes."
*   **Link Text:** **"Climb the tower →"**

**Card 5: Steam-Methane Reforming Plant**
*   **Badge (Top Left):** **"LEVEL 3 · CAPSTONE"** (Outline pill).
*   **Thumbnail Content:** Complex, dense PFD showing a full plant layout with many units, recycle loops, and heat exchangers.
*   **Title:** **"Steam-Methane Reforming Plant"**
*   **Description:** "The classic route: natural gas + steam to 1,000 t/d of ammonia. 19 units, 27 streams, a recycle loop, and three guided tours."
*   **Link Text:** **"Explore plant →"**

### 5) Footer Text
*   **Main Footer Text (Centered, below cards):** "Or skip the curriculum entirely — open the builder, describe the plant in your head, and the agents will engineer it in front of you."
*   **Bottom Bar Text (Centered, very bottom):** "Flowsheet — an AI-native process simulator for chemical engineering students and the curious."

### 6) Floating Buttons
*   **Bottom Left:** A circular, solid black button with a white letter **"N"** inside (likely a help or navigation widget).
*   **Bottom Right:** A floating action button (FAB), dark gray/black rounded rectangle with white text: **"⚡ Build with AI"** (The icon looks like a lightning bolt or sparkle).
